# 🛒 Northwind SQL → Python Analytics Pipeline  
### Data Engineering • Forecasting • Clustering • ETL Automation

An end-to-end analytics workflow built with SQL, Python, forecasting models, and customer segmentation techniques using the classic Northwind database.

<!-- EXEC SUMMARY -->
<div class="content-block fade-up">

# 📌 Executive Summary

This project demonstrates a complete business analytics pipeline, combining:

- **Advanced SQL queries** (CTEs, window functions, subqueries)  
- **ETL data processing in Python**  
- **Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)**  
- **ARIMA Forecasting** for monthly sales  
- **Customer Clustering (K-Means / RFM)**  
- **Business insights for inventory, performance, and marketing**

The project replicates a real-world analytics environment, showcasing an analyst’s ability to work across data extraction, transformation, modeling, and final recommendation delivery.

</div>

<!-- METHODS -->
<div class="content-block fade-up">

# 🔧 Methods & Techniques

### **SQL Engineering**
- Common Table Expressions (CTEs)  
- Window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, PARTITION BY)  
- Aggregation & joins across multiple tables  
- Performance ranking  
- Time-series SQL transformations  

### **Python ETL & Analytics**
- Data cleaning & preprocessing  
- Merging SQL extracts  
- Pandas-based automation  
- Visual analytics  

### **Forecasting**
- ARIMA model  
- AIC-based model selection  
- Forecast visualization  
- Seasonality & trend decomposition  

### **Customer Segmentation**
- RFM scoring  
- K-means clustering  
- Cluster interpretation & profiling  
- Customer lifetime value insights  

</div>

<!-- KEY INSIGHTS -->
<div class="content-block fade-up">

# 🔍 Key Insights

### 🧮 1. Employee Sales Performance
SQL window functions revealed top-performing employees and efficiency gaps across product lines.

### 📦 2. Category-Level Insights
CTEs showed strong seasonality across top-selling product categories.

### 📈 3. Sales Forecasting
ARIMA projections indicated steady growth trends, enabling improved inventory and supply planning.

### 👥 4. Customer Segmentation
RFM + K-means clustering identified:
- **High-value repeat customers**  
- **Seasonal bulk buyers**  
- **At-risk customers** who could be targeted for retention campaigns  

### 💡 5. Strategic Recommendations
- Improve targeting for high-value segments  
- Adjust inventory cycles around forecasted peaks  
- Increase visibility for high-margin categories  

</div>
